reserves.issuerOrObligor: USDrf (RealFi), USDCx (IOG xReserve bridge of Circle USDC), and Indigo PSM

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-10-29. Indigo's public analytics endpoint returned 1,282,043.802945 iUSD of debt on the native ADA branch (the API's empty collateral_asset denotes ADA) across 182 CDPs and 15,441.867011 iUSD on the NIGHT branch across 16 CDPs. Koios asset_info reported total iUSD supply of 1,342,868.808838. Indexed CDP debt therefore covers 1,297,485.669956 iUSD, represented as 95.4705% ADA and 1.1499% NIGHT after rounding; the 45,383.138882 iUSD residual is 3.3796%. The API responses do not expose one shared historical ledger point for CDP debt and supply, and the residual may include USDCx/USDM peg-stability or CDP paths not represented in the index, so it remains explicitly unresolved rather than normalized away.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Indigo analytics iUSD CDP index and Koios iUSD supply fetched 2026-10-29; indexed minted debt attributed by collateral branch, with residual retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 45,383.138882 iUSD residual is not attributed to individual CDPs; Indigo's PSM identifies it as peg-stability collateral, led by USDrf.
